title: Answer: the stream, the self and the illusion emerge from many unconscious processes

statements.text: What emerges is the apparent single stream of consciousness, from the competition of specialist circuits and a virtual serial machine, the user illusion of a unified person, from robots made of robots, and the illusion of phenomenality, from introspective representation of sensory states.

sources.quote: some get promoted to further functional roles
a user illusion of a Conscious Person
